title: TODO marker in a script comment
description: Unfinished-work rule — a comment step in a script carries a TODO marker (TODO, TO DO, TO-DO, TBD, to be done, to be defined). A TODO describes planned or optional work, not a defect, which is why the severity is info: the rule counts with its own figure but never turns the traffic light yellow. The defect half of the family is script_comment_fixme.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A TODO records work that was planned and postponed. That is a stock figure, not a defect — it says how much of the solution is still an intention. Rising TODO counts in a module are a maintenance signal; individual lines are not.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix per line. Use the inventory to spot modules where postponed work piles up, and move anything with an owner and a date into the tracker.

meta.name: TODO marker in a script comment
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Unfinished-work rule — a comment step carries a TODO marker. Detector canon of the family: (?i)(\bto[\s\-_]?do|\btbd\b|\bto[\s\-_]be[\s\-_](done|defined)\b), verified by tools/tests/rules/unfinished_work_detector.sql; the family deliberately omits the trailing word boundary so plural markers ("TO DOs") still match. Overlap with script_comment_fixme is intended: a comment line carrying both markers is counted by both rules, so the sum of the two rules can exceed the number of marked lines.
